findings.description: PHASE-DSC-168 (Vendor Runtime Profile Runtime Release Runtime Bundle) binds a shared artifact path (exports/direct_spatial_conditioning/v1/direct-spatial-conditioning-vendor-runtime-profile-runtime-release-final-certification-report-v1.json) via a generated builder module filename (services/directSpatialConditioningVendorRuntimeProfileRuntimeReleaseFinalCertificationReportBuilder.ts) that the phase-name generation pattern later reused/retargeted for PHASE-DSC-179 (12 phases later, same suffix family). The module now exports phase 'PHASE-DSC-179' identity constants, but PHASE-DSC-168's embedded binding literal 'runtime_profile_runtime_release_final_certification_report_evidence_mode' still hardcoded the stale label 'phase_167_pass_verdict_gated_at_build_time', and PHASE-DSC-168's docstrings / error strings still referenced the vanished PHASE-DSC-167 / PHASE-DSC-166 identities.
findings.root_cause: Generated-artifact filename collision across two logically distinct phases (167 and 179) sharing the same suffix-cycle name; PHASE-DSC-168 was never rebuilt after PHASE-DSC-179 retargeted the shared file, so its sealed report digest (1f4a70576284618563735d020ca5dfb0c97e4af61d165dc2b3e0a70e4763859b) drifted from the live PHASE-DSC-179 report digest (9c3c1a7518683088b8325a09bed18bf305f9116781eac30f6d0afc527ca29946).
findings.impact: Broken binding digest chain at 168 -> shared report, and transitively 169 -> 168 -> shared report; downstream sealed digests (170, 171, 172, 173) drifted in lockstep since each seals the immediately preceding phase's export digest.

findings.description: Binding digest chain broken for 168 -> report, and transitively 169 -> 168.

SELF phase constant DSC_VENDOR_RUNTIME_PROFILE_RUNTIME_RELEASE_RUNTIME_BUNDLE_PHASE was left unchanged at 'PHASE-DSC-168'. No functional gating logic changed: evidence.phase / evidence.final_verdict / evidence.error_count checks already referenced the correctly-imported PHASE-DSC-179 constants.
